note: F1a A4 static enumeration. Every className string under app/ and components/ (components/nos-chrome/, components/nos/ and app/(nos)/ excluded as NOS-host-only) that carries focus:ring-*, focus-visible:ring-*, ring-offset-* or focus(-visible):outline-none must be THE ONE RING: focus-visible:outline-2 + focus-visible:outline-solid + focus-visible:outline-offset-[3px] (+ an outline colour), with no ring-* utility and no outline-none. Anything else must be listed here with a reason. Each entry names a file and a key (a substring of the className string). An entry matching no hit FAILS the check (stale). Unlisted hits FAIL. Rule (NOS Design/lead): every standalone action (buttons, links, CTAs, programmatic focus targets such as error-summary wrappers with tabIndex -1, including the equipment tables' add/remove row buttons) takes the one ring and is NEVER allowlisted. Only nav links (NAV-1) and form-control fields are allowlisted, one entry per component, never a glob.
